about_the_game:
Because it's a 'fairytale' when a fairy tells it!

Fate's Theater is a mischievous fate engine where the fairies Fortune and Misfortune vie to twist mortal lives into rhyming couplets. Pair Mortal destinies and nudge the balance to reveal over 400 two-line tales – each branching toward a bright serendipity or a gleefully gruesome doom, depending on which fairy claims the moment.

In a nutshell, think of Fate's Theater as a cute little narrative toy, built around curiosity, rhyme, dark humor, and collecting strange little fates.

“Where mortal fates take wicked swings,
You choose which fairy pulls the strings!”

FEATURES

  • Tiny Tales — Over 400 two-line rhyming couplets revealed by pairing Mortals

  • Twin Fates — Each tale splits between Fortune's favor and Misfortune's wicked turn

  • Cute Meets Macabre — Unsuspecting mortals meet new friends… or meet terrible ends

  • Fate Collection — Grow your catalog of revealed fates and expand your cast of Mortals

  • Gentle Strategy — Simple rules with secret wagers and quiet mind games

  • Shadow Theater — Adorable puppet silhouettes with reactive, atmospheric music

  • Solo or Friendly Duels — Face a theatrical bot or invite a friend

  • Honest Indie — A polished coffee-break experience at a coffee's price, made with love


    “Fortune's kiss, Misfortune's curse,

    Who gets to write the final verse?”

    ☘︎💀☘︎💀☘︎💀☘︎
